visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene begins with a close-up look into a vintage wooden locker filled with memorabilia. Inside, there are several framed black-and-white photos, an iconic green glass desk lamp, stacks of weathered books, and various letters. A cartoon Einstein graphic is overlaid. (2) A young Asian man with short black hair, wearing a white hoodie under a beige jacket, stands outside a grand, multi-story stone building with classical arches. He gestures with his hands while speaking directly to the camera. (3) The camera follows the man as he enters through large wooden doors into a spacious interior with arched hallways and white pillars. He walks past other people and enters a modern elevator with silver buttons. (4) He reaches a hallway lined with tall, dark wood lockers. He identifies one specific door featuring a small round portrait and opens it. (5) Inside the locker, he showcases Einstein's personal items again, then pulls out a wooden drawer at the bottom to reveal a modern digital screen embedded within, displaying a spinning vinyl record graphic.

(3) A clear mechanical 'ping' and click sound trigger as the elevator button is pressed. The narrator continues his fast-paced explanation without interruption. (4) A metallic sliding sound indicates a locker or drawer being opened. The BGM remains constant throughout. The narrator's pitch rises slightly at the end to provide a positive, encouraging recommendation to the listener.
